relationships.subject: extended environmental enrichment
relationships.evidence_quote: extending the enrichment after the injury prevented the development of depression and reduced mechanical hypersensitivity

relationships.subject: extended environmental enrichment
relationships.evidence_quote: ACC neurons of neuropathic pain animals housed in standard conditions showed hyperexcitability as manifested by an increase in input resistance and a decrease of AP firing threshold, all of which could be reversed by environmental enrichment

key_findings: Extended but not early environmental enrichment gives resilience to SNI-induced depression-like behavior and reduces mechanical hypersensitivity.
ACC L2/3 pyramidal neuron hyperexcitability in SNI mice is reversed by enrichment and inversely correlates with resilience.
